security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Understand, compare, and navigate legal documents.
bundle.longDescription: Olai helps non-lawyers understand a legal notice and their agreement, compare them for conflicts, and navigate next steps with cited checklists and reminders. It is not a lawyer and does not give legal advice.
